baseline.method: Independent original OpenPIV run on packaged observations

reference_kind: standard-method baseline; independent physical ground truth unavailable
threshold_provenance: Fixed before local extraction: independent upstream reruns were bitwise identical; nonzero float64 numerical tolerances are checked against frozen independent stage fixtures and known translations.
confidence_relative_l2_definition: norm(predicted confidence - reference confidence) / norm(reference confidence)
nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((prediction-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), jointly over both signed velocity components
